implement_runstore_put: implement a RunStore subclass that stores a new run with thread id and metadata
implement_runstore_get: implement a RunStore subclass that retrieves a run by its run id
implement_runstore_list_by_thread: implement a RunStore subclass that lists runs belonging to a specific thread
implement_runstore_update_status: implement a RunStore subclass that updates the status and error of an existing run
implement_runstore_aggregate_tokens: implement a RunStore subclass that aggregates token usage stats for completed runs in a thread
